Value quoted as '~10^12' (no error). NOT a measurement: this paper gives NO usable SED stellar mass for the host.

The paper says the optical emission is dominated by a quasar (citing Tsukui+2023); the implied bound is stars + halo < ~27% of the dynamical mass at 4 kpc. Arithmetic is the authors', not repeated here.

caveat: NOT a stellar mass. M_dyn = 1.0e11 sin^-2(i) Msun; total molecular mass 9.2e10 Msun; M_BH=6e9 Msun (Shields+2006).
